Field Application Specialist

Field Application Specialist at Fukuoka Sanno Hospital

Responsibilities

  • Guide the software transition from development to implementation.
  • Provide customer training after installation.
  • Be the main point of contact for Cath lab clients, offering support.
  • Relay client feedback to R&D and management.
  • Help introduce new products and upgrades.
  • Document and address user-reported issues.
  • Validate clinical use cases and perform usability testing.

Qualifications

  • Pursuing a degree in fields like Biology, Medicine, Biomedical Engineering, etc.
  • Self-motivated and organized with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient in Japanese and English.
  • Comfortable in a Cath Lab clinical environment.
  • Tech-savvy with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong interpersonal skills

    KOL Manager

    We seek an experienced Key Opinion Leader (KOL) Manager to cultivate relationships with influential cardiology experts, drive engagement, and contribute to cutting-edge healthcare solutions at our location in Playa Vista, Los Angeles.

    Responsibilities:

    • Identify and prioritize key opinion leaders in the field of cardiology.
    • Foster long-term relationships with cardiology KOLs.
    • Coordinate and support participation in various industry events, such as conferences, panels, round tables, webinars, and workshops.
    • Assist with the invitation and accommodation of KOLs for relevant events.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for content creation and product development.
    • Organize advisory board meetings and events.
    • Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends in cardiology.

    Qualifications:

    • Bachelor’s degree (advanced degree preferred).
    • Proven track record in cardiology KOL management.
    • Strong network within the cardiology community.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
    • Familiarity with healthcare regulatory guidelines.

      FRONT-END DEVELOPER

      Responsibilities:

      • Build the front-end of applications through appealing visual design

      • Write effective test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency, Troubleshoot and debug

      • Create security and data protection settings

      Requirements

      • Proven experience as a Front-End Developer or similar role for 2 years minimum

      • Experience developing desktop and mobile applications, knowledge on QT (is a must) / Visual Studio.

      Skills

      • Knowledge of multiple front-end languages and libraries (e.g. HTML/ CSS, JavaScript, XML, jQuery)

      • Knowledge of multiple back-end languages (e.g. C#, Java, Python) and JavaScript frameworks (e.g. Angular, React, Node.js)

      • Familiarity with databases (e.g. MySQL, MongoDB), web servers (e.g. Apache) and UI/UX design
